|game_text=Deploy on table. Once per game, unless [Virtual] [[Crossfire]] on table (or out of play), may use 3 Force to take an Effect that deploys on a location (except Expand The Empire) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Your non-Dark Jedi characters without [Permanent Weapon] or [Maintenance] are immune to [[Goo Nee Tay]]. May not be canceled. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Breached Defenses & •Molator (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009; the slip and the Players Committee card image print it): “Deploy on table. Once per game, unless [Virtual] Crossfire on table (or out of play), may use 3 Force to ▲ an Effect that deploys on a location (except Expand The Empire). If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Your non-Dark Jedi characters without [Permanent Weapon] or [Maintenance] are immune to Goo Nee Tay. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; this copy re-made 20 April 2010, first posted as the Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, 3 September 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the release-sheet wording again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Breached Defenses & •Molator (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Breached Defenses & •Molator (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “(except Expand the Empire)” with a small “t” and “it is instead lost at the end of battle” (the slip has “at end of battle”). PC-E1 text: “Deploy on table. Once per game, unless [Virtual] Crossfire on table (or out of play), may use 3 Force to take an Effect that deploys on a location (except Expand the Empire) into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at the end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Your non-Dark Jedi characters without [Permanent Weapon] or [Maintenance] are immune to Goo Nee Tay. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1261_29">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the same text is in the VMasterType list</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
